open_points.subject: unknown reference refusal ownership
open_points.text: State 3: "It gives the \"unknown reference\" refusal and masks under A07"; State 4: "A request naming a record that does not exist is refused as an unknown reference by the module that owns the record"
open_points.question: Which module must emit the external unknown-reference refusal: surface, or the record-owning module?
options: surface emits the unknown-reference refusal after lower modules report not found
the record-owning module emits the unknown-reference refusal directly

open_points.subject: binding acceptance re-check scope
open_points.text: A08 rule 7: "a `proposed` one is checked again by every check of rule 5, those of the instance included"; State 4 accept step: "a `proposed` one is read against the manifest again as before a send (A08 rule 6)"
open_points.question: On accept_binding, must the kernel re-run all A08 rule 5 checks (including instance checks), or only the send-time stale/record checks of rule 6?
options: re-run all rule-5 checks, including instance checks
run only rule-6 send-time record checks

open_points.subject: effect outcome store-write failure after send
open_points.text: State 4: "A second store call writes the outcome" and "a store call that fails changes nothing ... the request is answered as an internal error"
open_points.question: If the send already happened but the second store call fails, what must happen to process/run state immediately (before any restart)?
options: keep process running, return internal error, leave attempt `in_flight` until a later restart recovers it
stop the process immediately so startup recovery converts `in_flight` to `unknown` before any further requests
retry the outcome write within the same request until it succeeds
open_points.default_guess: keep process running and leave the attempt `in_flight` until restart
